generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated palette-and-material clue for a character-gallery card
Primary request: create a single premium tactile blue short-pile plush material specimen whose color and fiber character match the blue surface in Image 1. Make this unmistakably a material swatch, not a character.
Subject: one softly curved rounded-square swatch cut from blue plush, with a visible short-pile fabric edge and a small folded corner showing textile thickness. The swatch itself is a simple abstract sample with no recognizable body silhouette.
Style/medium: refined soft 3D product illustration, detailed fibers, restrained highlights.
Composition/framing: centered, fully visible, compact specimen occupying about 70% of a square canvas.
Lighting/mood: soft studio lighting, crisp detail, no dramatic glow.
Color palette: saturated cobalt blue with subtle lighter-blue fiber highlights matching Image 1.
Materials/textures: dense short velvety pile, visible texture across the swatch face and edge.
Constraints: transparent background with true alpha; no ground plane or cast shadow. No sphere, orb, round character body, eyes, face, limbs, accessories, garment, text, logo, frame, or UI.
